plan.notes: BA in Business Administration. Official Monmouth College 'Academic Plan' (sample plan). One Monmouth course credit = 4 credit-hours; credits modeled in Monmouth course credits exactly as printed. The plan places major courses and first-year Core Foundations; remaining credits each term are filled with Core Requirements or general electives per the plan's instructions (those fillers are not modeled). Italics in the source indicate prerequisites exist - see the catalog for chains; not modeled here. 'Or' rows occupying one slot are modeled as single choice slots. Flexible 'take in either term' rows are modeled in the first-listed term and documented. Pages undated (retrieved 2026-10-09); catalog_year labeled 2026-2027. Degree requires 31 course credits; 13 major credits stated on the page (12 placed as printed - documented). BUSI 105/ECON 200 and ENGL 110/COMM 101 are each printed in both Year 1 terms (take once); modeled in Fall and Spring respectively. BUSI 105 meets the Inquiry in the Social Sciences Core requirement; ECON 200 meets the same; BUSI 205 meets the Quantitative Reasoning in Practice Core requirement.
